Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: This message is used by Data Recipients to login to the TCP Retransmission Service.

Field.Name: User
Field.Description: As provided by BOX (for future use)

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: As provided by BOX (for future use)

Message.Name: Login Acknowledgement Message
Message.Description: On successful login, BOX returns an acknowledgement to the Data Recipient.

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: This message is used by Data Recipients to logout from the TCP Retransmission Service.

Message.Name: Logout Acknowledgement Message
Message.Description: This message acknowledges the successful logout of Data Recipient from the TCP Retransmission Service.

Message.Name: Retransmission Request Message
Message.Description: This message is used by Data Recipient to request retransmission of messages by Retransmission Request Types.

Field.Name: Line Name

Field.Description: Zero filled 0x00

Field.Name: End Message Sequence Number
Field.Description: Ending Message Sequence number

Message.Name: Retransmission Begin Message
Message.Description: This message is to inform Data Recipients about the beginning of a Retransmission.

Message.Name: Retransmission End Message
Message.Description: This message is to inform Data Recipients about the End of a Retransmission.

Message.Description: Indicates the last message number sent for each line of that trading slice.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: The Heartbeat message is sent out if no messages are sent by BOX for more than one second after the broadcast has started.
